--[[
	NestedEmit: source-walk dispatcher for nested transformed Part-Icles.

	Walks the SOURCE RenderTemplate (never clones nested-source subtrees). Each transformed leaf fires
	via particle:EnableEmit with link=clonedRoot, which EmitPart's link branch uses for the spawn pose
	and per-frame tracking. parentAlive cancels nested closures when the parent's pData is reclaimed.
]]

local Pool = require(script.Parent.Pool)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

local NestedEmit = {}

-- Nearest ancestor with a world frame (BasePart / Attachment / Model / Bone), up to the RT root.
local function nearestFrameAncestor(node, sourceRT)
	local cur = node.Parent
	while cur and cur ~= sourceRT do
		if cur:IsA("BasePart") or cur:IsA("Attachment") or cur:IsA("Model") then return cur end
		cur = cur.Parent
	end
	return sourceRT
end

-- Walks the source RT and fires each Transformed leaf.
--   scaleNode: parent-Model scale chain node each leaf inherits as descCtx.ParentScale.
--   _parentCloneMap: Pool's source-to-clone map, so nested Trail/Beam can rebind Attachment0/1.
--   _linkLocal: the leaf's parent-node offset from the RT root, so a leaf under a Model sub-part
--     spawns and tracks there; nil at the root. _sourceParentCF composes the spawn rotation
--     relative to that parent node instead of doubling its world rotation.
--   decorate(node, descCtx): optional, runs last on each leaf's context (a Container gives each
--     leaf its drive record and keepPlace). _containerDrive and _matte are forwarded to deeper
--     leaves; _rigPlace never is.
function NestedEmit.walk(particle, sourceRT, clonedRoot, parentAlive, emitCtx, scaleNode, decorate)
	if parentAlive and parentAlive[1] == false then return end
	local parentCloneMap = Pool.cloneMapOf(clonedRoot)
	-- Chains to the grandparent's map so a leaf resolves attachments authored one level up; pool hits
	-- reuse the map, so the chain is refreshed each time.
	local grandMap = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if parentCloneMap and grandMap and grandMap ~= parentCloneMap then
		local mt = getmetatable(parentCloneMap)
		if mt then mt.__index = grandMap else setmetatable(parentCloneMap, { __index = grandMap }) end
	end
	local leaves = {}
	local function visit(node)
		if node:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
			leaves[#leaves + 1] = node
			return
		end
		for _, child in node:GetChildren() do visit(child) end
	end
	visit(sourceRT)
	if #leaves == 0 then return end
	local rootCF = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(sourceRT)
	local function fire(node)
		local descCtx = { ParentScale = scaleNode }
		local parentNode = nearestFrameAncestor(node, sourceRT)
		local parentCF = (parentNode == sourceRT) and rootCF or Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(parentNode)
		descCtx._sourceParentCF = parentCF
		if parentNode ~= sourceRT then descCtx._linkLocal = rootCF:ToObjectSpace(parentCF) end
		if emitCtx then
			descCtx.ChainCtx  = emitCtx.ChainCtx
			descCtx.EmitIndex = emitCtx.EmitIndex
			descCtx.EmitCount = emitCtx.EmitCount
			-- The same play token, so PlayHandle:Disable / SetTimescale / GetParticles reach nested particles.
			descCtx._playToken = emitCtx._playToken
			descCtx._containerDrive = emitCtx._containerDrive
			descCtx._matte = emitCtx._matte
		end
		descCtx._parentAlive = parentAlive
		descCtx._parentCloneMap = parentCloneMap
		if decorate then decorate(node, descCtx) end
		particle:EnableEmit(node, clonedRoot, descCtx)
	end
	-- Attachment emitters first: EmitAttachment registers its visual in the map, so sibling Beams and
	-- Trails fired in the same walk bind their ends to it.
	for _, node in ipairs(leaves) do
		if node:IsA("Attachment") then fire(node) end
	end
	for _, node in ipairs(leaves) do
		if not node:IsA("Attachment") then fire(node) end
	end
end


-- Gives a leaf its own place under the root: its link offset becomes its own frame in the
-- RenderTemplate instead of its parent node's. A leaf with no frame (a light, a beam) stays on its
-- parent node. _rigPlace is that place for types that read no _linkLocal (Rocks, Lightning, Rope
-- PDataBuilder; CameraShake and Distortion by position). Called from a Container's and a Matte's
-- decorate.
function NestedEmit.keepPlace(node, descCtx, sourceRT)
	if not (node:IsA("BasePart") or node:IsA("Attachment") or node:IsA("Model")) then
		return
	end
	local own = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(node)
	descCtx._linkLocal = Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(sourceRT):ToObjectSpace(own)
	descCtx._rigPlace = descCtx._linkLocal
	-- LinkCF.spawnFrame adds the leaf's rotation relative to this frame.
	descCtx._sourceParentCF = own
end

-- Clone-side parent for a nested visual: the parent's copyBare clone of the source's nearest
-- BasePart ancestor, else the parent clone root if a BasePart. nil when not nested-driven or
-- nothing suitable was cloned. Consumer: EmitAttachment, which keeps emitted visuals inside the
-- parent clone instead of the source RenderTemplate.
function NestedEmit.resolveCloneParent(sourceNode, link, emitCtx)
	if not emitCtx then return nil end
	local map = emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if map then
		local node = sourceNode.Parent
		while node and node ~= workspace do
			local clone = map[node]
			if clone then
				if clone:IsA("BasePart") then return clone end
				break
			end
			node = node.Parent
		end
	end
	if emitCtx._parentAlive and link and link:IsA("BasePart") then return link end
	return nil
end

-- Clone-side holder of a light or sound: the parent copy's copy of the part or attachment the
-- source sits in. nil when not nested-driven or that node was not copied.
-- Consumer: Particle._rideHost (PointLight).
function NestedEmit.cloneOfHolder(sourceNode, emitCtx)
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if not map then return nil end
	local holder = sourceNode.Parent
	local clone = holder and map[holder]
	if clone and (clone:IsA("BasePart") or clone:IsA("Attachment")) then return clone end
	return nil
end

-- Emit Into for a leaf its parent emits: a target inside the parent's RenderTemplate, or the parent
-- emitter itself, is the same place in this copy, so each copy holds its own leaf. Read from the
-- parent's own map, not the grandparent's (a leaf would sit in a copy whose end it never hears of).
-- nil for any other target, a top-level play, or a parent with no map (Animate, rigs).
-- Consumer: Particle:GetEmitData (EmitOverrides).
function NestedEmit.copyOf(target, emitCtx)
	local map = emitCtx and emitCtx._parentCloneMap
	if not map or not target then return nil end
	if not target:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
		return rawget(map, target)
	end
	local template = target:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not template then return nil end
	return rawget(map, template)
end

-- The parent's alive flag for a light, sound, Container or Matte whose visual sits inside the
-- parent's copy: it ends with that copy, so a pooled copy never carries it into its next play.
-- nil for a top-level play or an Emit Into elsewhere. Engine.step ends the play.
function NestedEmit.parentAliveFor(data, emitCtx)
	if not (emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive) then return nil end
	if data.EmitParent and not data.EmitIntoCopy then return nil end
	return emitCtx._parentAlive
end

-- The parent's alive flag for any play Emit Into put inside its parent's copy. Resolves the leaf's
-- own Emit Into by copyOf. nil otherwise. Consumers: Particle:_registerEmit; Engine.step.
function NestedEmit.emitIntoAlive(item, emitCtx)
	if not (item and emitCtx and emitCtx._parentAlive and emitCtx._parentCloneMap) then return nil end
	local emitInto = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
	if not (emitInto and emitInto:IsA("ObjectValue")) then return nil end
	if not NestedEmit.copyOf(emitInto.Value, emitCtx) then return nil end
	return emitCtx._parentAlive
end

return NestedEmit

--[[
	NestedScale  -  what an emitted copy holds, kept to the scale of the Model it is nested in.

	A Model's Scale reaches the plain things in its own copy through Model:ScaleTo. A mesh or
	an Attachment nested in that Model is a play of its own: the Model's factor sizes it and
	scales its motion (UpdatePart, UpdateAttachment), and this module does the same for what
	its copy holds, which Transform moved into its RenderTemplate: the Attachments, set apart
	by the factor, and the plain Beams between them (widths, curve sizes, segments, and the
	texture's length when the Model's Scale Texture is on).

	  NestedScale.textureScales(beam) -> boolean
	      TextureLength is studs a repeat in Wrap and Static, and a count of repeats along the
	      whole beam in Stretch, which a scale leaves alone. UpdateBeam asks it for a nested
	      Beam's own visual.
	  NestedScale.start(visual, parentScale, factor, driveScale) -> record or nil
	      at the emit of a nested Part or Attachment, before its copy is parented. nil when
	      the copy holds nothing to scale. driveScale: the Scale of the Container that carries
	      the play (nil for none), with which parentScale may be nil.
	  NestedScale.apply(record, factor, driveScale)
	      every frame from the update; writes only when a factor moved.
	  NestedScale.restore(record)
	      before the copy returns to the pool (LifecycleRelease._releaseVisual), so the next
	      play finds it as it was copied.

	Mutates a CLONE only: start is called from EmitPart and EmitAttachment, never from the
	Animate emits, whose visual is the live RenderTemplate.
	The scale a copy is made at: an Animate Model plays its live RenderTemplate and its ScaleTo
	scales the templates inside it, so a copy of one comes out at the Model's scale of that
	moment, and what it holds is scaled from there. Under a Model that emits a copy a template
	is never scaled. The copy keeps that scale as the attribute _copiedScale (RESERVED_ATTRS.md),
	because a pooled copy is taken again when the live Model stands at another scale.
	A part or a model inside the copy is not moved, so what it holds is left with it.
	A Container that carries the copy sets its Attachments apart by its own Scale as well
	(driveScale). It does not act on the Beams here: their widths and curve sizes are the
	Container's to write every frame (Container/Lines).
]]

local NestedScale = {}

function NestedScale.textureScales(beam)
	return beam.TextureMode ~= Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
end

-- The scale `visual` was copied at: the scale of the nearest Model above that plays its live
-- RenderTemplate, 1 when every Model above emits a copy.
local function copiedAt(visual, parentScale)
	local kept = visual:GetAttribute("_copiedScale")
	if kept then
		return kept
	end
	local node = parentScale
	while node do
		local owner = node.Owner
		if owner and owner.IsAnimate then
			local live = owner.VisualPart
			if live and live.Parent then
				return math.max(live:GetScale(), 0.001)
			end
			return 1
		end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return 1
end

-- Lists the Attachments and Beams under `holder`, with what they are now.
local function collect(holder, record)
	for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
		if child:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then
			continue
		end
		if child:IsA("Attachment") then
			table.insert(record.attachments, child)
			table.insert(record.positions, child.Position)
			collect(child, record)
		elseif child:IsA("Beam") then
			table.insert(record.beams, child)
			table.insert(record.shapes, {
				width0 = child.Width0,
				width1 = child.Width1,
				curveSize0 = child.CurveSize0,
				curveSize1 = child.CurveSize1,
				segments = child.Segments,
				textureLength = (record.scaleTexture and NestedScale.textureScales(child)) and child.TextureLength or nil,
			})
		elseif not (child:IsA("BasePart") or child:IsA("Model")) then
			collect(child, record)
		end
	end
end

function NestedScale.start(visual, parentScale, factor, driveScale)
	if not parentScale and not driveScale then
		return nil
	end
	local copied = 1
	if parentScale then
		copied = copiedAt(visual, parentScale)
	end
	local record = {
		copied = copied,
		factor = copied,
		drive = 1,
		scaleTexture = parentScale ~= nil and parentScale.ScaleTextureLength ~= false,
		attachments = {},
		positions = {},
		beams = {},
		shapes = {},
	}
	collect(visual, record)
	if #record.attachments == 0 and #record.beams == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	if copied ~= 1 then
		visual:SetAttribute("_copiedScale", copied)
	end
	NestedScale.apply(record, factor, driveScale)
	return record
end

function NestedScale.apply(record, factor, driveScale)
	driveScale = driveScale or 1
	if factor == record.factor and driveScale == record.drive then
		return
	end
	local grew = factor ~= record.factor
	record.factor = factor
	record.drive = driveScale
	local grown = factor / record.copied
	local positions = record.positions
	for index, attachment in ipairs(record.attachments) do
		attachment.Position = positions[index] * (grown * driveScale)
	end
	if not grew then
		return
	end
	local shapes = record.shapes
	for index, beam in ipairs(record.beams) do
		local shape = shapes[index]
		beam.Width0 = shape.width0 * grown
		beam.Width1 = shape.width1 * grown
		beam.CurveSize0 = shape.curveSize0 * grown
		beam.CurveSize1 = shape.curveSize1 * grown
		beam.Segments = math.max(shape.segments, math.round(shape.segments * grown))
		if shape.textureLength then
			beam.TextureLength = shape.textureLength * grown
		end
	end
end

function NestedScale.restore(record)
	NestedScale.apply(record, record.copied, 1)
end

return NestedScale

--[[
	Orientation Mixin  -  per-frame rotation overlay for Part / Model / Attachment.
	Modes mirror ParticleOrientation: None, FacingCamera, FacingCameraWorldUp,
	VelocityParallel, VelocityPerpendicular. Composes as `orient * existingRotation`.
	ApplyZOffset runs after this and keeps the rotation written here (ZOffset.luau).
]]

local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)

return function(Particle)

local EPS = 1e-3
local Y_AXIS = Vector3.yAxis
local X_AXIS = Vector3.xAxis
local DEFAULT_VEL = -Vector3.zAxis

function Particle:ApplyOrientation(pData, dt, camPos)
	local mode = pData.Orientation
	if not mode or mode == "None" then return end
	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return end
	local t = pData.Type
	if t ~= "Part" and t ~= "Model" and t ~= "Attachment" then return end

	local isModel = t == "Model"
	local isAttachment = t == "Attachment"
	-- Uses the pre-overlay base CFrame; reading live would compound the previous frame's compose.
	local currentCF = pData._postUpdateCF or (isModel and pData.VisualPart:GetPivot() or pData.VisualPart.CFrame)

	-- Attachment.CFrame is parent-local; work in world space, convert back on write.
	local parentPart
	if isAttachment then
		parentPart = pData.VisualPart.Parent
		if parentPart and parentPart:IsA("BasePart") then
			currentCF = parentPart.CFrame * currentCF
		else
			parentPart = nil
		end
	end

	local pos = currentCF.Position
	local existingRot = currentCF - pos

	local vel
	if pData._lastOrientPos then
		vel = (pos - pData._lastOrientPos) / math.max(dt, 1e-4)
	else
		vel = pData.BaseDirection or DEFAULT_VEL
	end
	pData._lastOrientPos = pos

	local orientRot
	if mode == "FacingCamera" then
		if not camPos then return end
		local toCam = camPos - pos
		if toCam.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, toCam.Unit)
	elseif mode == "FacingCameraWorldUp" then
		-- Yaw-only: flatten camera direction onto XZ so mesh rotates around world Y only.
		if not camPos then return end
		local toCam = camPos - pos
		local flat = Vector3.new(toCam.X, 0, toCam.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, flat.Unit, Y_AXIS)
	elseif mode == "VelocityParallel" then
		-- DirMode=Local already aligns via LocalCF; overlaying here would double-rotate.
		if pData.VelocityVectored then return end
		-- forward = velocity, roll tracks camera so broadside stays visible.
		if vel.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		local upHint = camPos and (camPos - pos) or Y_AXIS
		if upHint.Magnitude < EPS then upHint = Y_AXIS end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, vel.Unit, upHint.Unit)
	elseif mode == "VelocityPerpendicular" then
		-- up = velocity, forward fixed in world-horizontal plane.
		if vel.Magnitude < EPS then return end
		local upV = vel.Unit
		local fwd = upV:Cross(Y_AXIS)
		if fwd.Magnitude < EPS then fwd = upV:Cross(X_AXIS) end
		orientRot = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, fwd.Unit, upV)
	else
		-- Warns once per pData on an unknown Orientation.
		if not pData._orientWarned then
			pData._orientWarned = true
			Log.warn("Part-Icles: unknown Orientation '" .. tostring(pData.Orientation) .. "' on emitted particle  -  falling back to identity.")
		end
		return
	end

	local newCF = CFrame.new(pos) * orientRot * existingRot

	if parentPart then
		newCF = parentPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(newCF)
	end

	if isModel then
		pData.VisualPart:PivotTo(newCF)
	else
		pData.VisualPart.CFrame = newCF
	end
end

end

--[[
	PartConstants  -  lookup tables and helpers shared by Emit / Update / Transform.
	  DirectionVectors[NormalId] → (axis, multiplier) for CFrame component reads.
	  shapeFunctions[ParticleEmitterShape] → (offset, rotation, direction) per shape.
	  resolveLinkCFrame, composeRotation, applyPositionOffset  -  see per-function comments.
	  resolveDisplacement, TURNING_DISPLACEMENT, midRotation  -  the frames of the PosOffset graphs.
]]

local PartConstants = {}

-- Type-dispatched world CFrame: Bone→TransformedWorldCFrame (animated pose), Attachment→WorldCFrame,
-- Model→GetPivot, else .CFrame. Bone inherits Attachment, so its test must run first.
function PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	if link:IsA("Bone") then return link.TransformedWorldCFrame end
	if link:IsA("Attachment") then return link.WorldCFrame end
	if link:IsA("Model") then return link:GetPivot() end
	return link.CFrame
end

-- Where a play with no visual of its own stands on its parent's emitted copy: the middle of the
-- copy, or `place` (NestedEmit.keepPlace).
function PartConstants.placeOnLink(link, place)
	local frame = PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
	if place then
		return frame:PointToWorldSpace(place)
	end
	return frame.Position
end

-- Where a play that stands at its source starts: the source's frame, or the origin an EmitAt play
-- names (a position alone keeps the source's rotation). The second value is true when the play is
-- tied to its source.
function PartConstants.playOrigin(sourceCFrame, emitCtx)
	local origin = nil
	if emitCtx then
		if emitCtx.EventOriginResolver then
			origin = emitCtx.EventOriginResolver()
		end
		origin = origin or emitCtx.EventOriginCF
	end
	if not origin then
		return sourceCFrame, true
	end
	if emitCtx.UseFullOrigin then
		return origin, false
	end
	return CFrame.new(origin.Position) * sourceCFrame.Rotation, false
end

-- Compounded scale of a nested particle's parent-Model chain. `parentScale` is `pData.ParentScale`,
-- a linked list via `.Parent` of { Owner, ScaleMotion, ScaleRotation, ScaleTextureLength, Parent };
-- each level contributes its owner's `_ownScale`. nil gives 1. `gate`: nil = all levels, "motion" or
-- "rotation" = only levels with that flag. GraphMod is passed in so this file requires nothing.
function PartConstants.getParentScaleFactor(parentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, gate)
	local factor = 1
	local ps = parentScale
	while ps do
		local include = true
		if gate == "motion" then include = ps.ScaleMotion ~= false
		elseif gate == "rotation" then include = ps.ScaleRotation == true end
		if include then
			local owner = ps.Owner
			local levelF = owner and owner._ownScale
			if not levelF then
				if owner and owner._staticScale then
					levelF = owner._staticScale
				elseif owner and owner.Graphs and owner.Graphs.Scale then
					local pI = math.clamp((currentTime - owner.StartTime) / owner.LifeTime, 0, 1)
					levelF = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(pI, owner.Graphs.Scale, owner.Seeds.Scale)
				else
					levelF = 1
				end
			end
			factor = factor * math.max(0.001, levelF)
		end
		ps = ps.Parent
	end
	return factor
end

-- LocalABC orders are intrinsic Euler (body-frame, left to right). Global is Y*X*Z about fixed world
-- axes. When the emission axis aligns with a rotation axis, an intrinsic order can no-op that axis on
-- the launch direction; Global gives the usual spread cone.
function PartConstants.composeRotation(order, rotXdeg, rotYdeg, rotZdeg)
	local rxCF = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(rotXdeg), 0, 0)
	local ryCF = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(rotYdeg), 0)
	local rzCF = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(rotZdeg))
	if order == "LocalXYZ" then return rxCF * ryCF * rzCF end
	if order == "LocalXZY" then return rxCF * rzCF * ryCF end
	if order == "LocalYXZ" then return ryCF * rxCF * rzCF end
	if order == "LocalYZX" then return ryCF * rzCF * rxCF end
	if order == "LocalZXY" then return rzCF * rxCF * ryCF end
	if order == "LocalZYX" then return rzCF * ryCF * rxCF end
	return ryCF * rxCF * rzCF
end

PartConstants.DirectionVectors = {
	[Enum.NormalId.Top]    = {vector = "UpVector",    multiplier = 1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Bottom] = {vector = "UpVector",    multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Front]  = {vector = "LookVector",  multiplier = 1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Back]   = {vector = "LookVector",  multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Left]   = {vector = "RightVector", multiplier = -1},
	[Enum.NormalId.Right]  = {vector = "RightVector", multiplier = 1},
}

-- Each shape returns (offset, lookAtRotation, outwardDirection).
-- rotation applied only when LookAtInitially is true; direction sign-modulated by ShapeInOut.
PartConstants.shapeFunctions = {
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box] = function(p, emitter)
		local Px = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.X / 2
		local Py = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.Y / 2
		local Pz = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * p.Size.Z / 2
		-- Box has no radial; use offset.Unit (origin-aligned falls back to world up).
		local offset = Vector3.new(Px, Py, Pz)
		local dir = offset.Magnitude > 1e-4 and offset.Unit or Vector3.yAxis
		local sRot = offset.Magnitude > 1e-4 and CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -dir) or CFrame.new()
		return offset, sRot, dir
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Sphere] = function(p, emitter)
		local outerRadius = p.Size.X / 2
		local innerRadius = outerRadius * emitter.ShapePartial
		local randomRadius = (math.random() * (outerRadius^3 - innerRadius^3) + innerRadius^3)^(1/3)
		local theta = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local phi = math.acos((math.random() * 2) - 1)
		local direction = Vector3.new(
			math.sin(phi) * math.cos(theta),
			math.sin(phi) * math.sin(theta),
			math.cos(phi)
		)
		return direction * randomRadius, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Cylinder] = function(p, emitter)
		local radius = p.Size.X / 2
		local height = p.Size.Y
		-- Area-uniform annulus radius: F^-1(u) = sqrt(u*(1-h^2) + h^2).
		local h = math.clamp(emitter.ShapePartial, 0, 1)
		local randomRadius = math.sqrt(math.random() * (1 - h * h) + h * h)
		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local x = randomRadius * radius * math.cos(angle)
		local y = (math.random() * 2 - 1) * (height / 2)
		local z = randomRadius * radius * math.sin(angle)
		local localOffset = Vector3.new(x, y, z)
		local direction
		if math.abs(y) > (height / 2) - 0.01 then
			direction = Vector3.new(0, math.sign(y), 0)
		else
			local lateral = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
			if lateral.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
				direction = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			else
				direction = lateral.Unit
			end
		end
		return localOffset, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
	[Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Disc] = function(p, emitter)
		local radius = p.Size.X / 2
		-- Area-uniform annulus; matches Cylinder.
		local h = math.clamp(emitter.ShapePartial, 0, 1)
		local randomRadiusRatio = math.sqrt(math.random() * (1 - h * h) + h * h)
		local angle = math.random() * 2 * math.pi
		local x = randomRadiusRatio * radius * math.cos(angle)
		local z = randomRadiusRatio * radius * math.sin(angle)
		local localOffset = Vector3.new(x, 0, z)
		if localOffset.Magnitude < 0.0001 then
			return localOffset, CFrame.new(), Vector3.yAxis
		end
		local direction = localOffset.Unit
		return localOffset, CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(), -direction), direction
	end,
}

-- Applies the PosX/Y/Z range offset to simCF. simFrameCF: world CFrame of the frame simCF is in;
-- nil = world-space sim.
function PartConstants.applyPositionOffset(simCF, data, link, item, RangeMod, AxisLinksMod, emitCtx, simFrameCF, scaleFactor)
	-- AxisLinks-aware sampling keeps linked followers correlated; emitCtx drives the Even spread.
	local pxS, pyS, pzS
	if AxisLinksMod and data.AxisLinks then
		local s = AxisLinksMod.sampleRangeAxes(data, data.AxisLinks, {"PosX","PosY","PosZ"}, RangeMod, emitCtx)
		pxS, pyS, pzS = s.PosX, s.PosY, s.PosZ
	else
		pxS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosX or NumberRange.new(0))
		pyS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosY or NumberRange.new(0))
		pzS = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.PosZ or NumberRange.new(0))
	end
	local px, py, pz = pxS, pyS, pzS
	-- Nested-Model scale: a 2x model spawns its particles' Pos spread 2x wider.
	if scaleFactor and scaleFactor ~= 1 then
		px, py, pz = px * scaleFactor, py * scaleFactor, pz * scaleFactor
	end
	if px == 0 and py == 0 and pz == 0 then return simCF end
	local posMode = data.PosMode or "Local"

	if posMode == "Local" then
		return simCF * CFrame.new(px, py, pz)
	end

	local offset = Vector3.new(px, py, pz)
	local worldOffset
	if posMode == "Global" then
		worldOffset = offset
	else -- RigidLocal: rotate by source's WORLD frame; composes through full nest chain.
		local rotCF
		if link then
			rotCF = PartConstants.resolveLinkCFrame(link)
		elseif item:IsA("Attachment") then
			rotCF = item.WorldCFrame
		elseif item:IsA("Model") then
			rotCF = item:GetPivot()
		else
			rotCF = item.CFrame
		end
		worldOffset = rotCF:VectorToWorldSpace(offset)
	end

	-- Convert world offset → caller's sim frame. nil = sim is world-space.
	local applyOffset = simFrameCF and simFrameCF:VectorToObjectSpace(worldOffset) or worldOffset
	return CFrame.new(simCF.Position + applyOffset) * simCF.Rotation
end

-- Resolves a PosOffset graph sample (rawOff) into a world-frame displacement by mode:
--   "Global"     no rotation
--   "RigidLocal" rotated by emitterRot (emitter frame at spawn, pre-RotXYZ)
--   "Local" (or unknown) rotated by spawnRot (post-RotXYZ particle frame)
--   "Rotating" takes the Local branch for its frame at spawn; later steps are turned by
--   UpdateCommon._turnedFrameDelta and PreSimulate.
-- mirrorX/Y/Z (optional) reflect the result about hit normals for OnHit Bounce; nil skips it.
function PartConstants.resolveDisplacement(rawOff, mode, spawnRot, emitterRot, mirrorX, mirrorY, mirrorZ)
	local frameOff
	if mode == "Global" then
		frameOff = rawOff
	elseif mode == "RigidLocal" then
		frameOff = emitterRot:VectorToWorldSpace(rawOff)
	else
		frameOff = spawnRot:VectorToWorldSpace(rawOff)
	end
	if mirrorX then
		return mirrorX * frameOff.X + mirrorY * frameOff.Y + mirrorZ * frameOff.Z
	end
	return frameOff
end

-- DisplacementMode whose PosOffset graphs run along the particle's own axes as it turns.
-- UIBuilder/BuildPropertiesDefs (the panel's option) and OptCalc name it by the same string.
PartConstants.TURNING_DISPLACEMENT = "Rotating"

-- Rotation half-way between two sets of angles (degrees): the frame a "Rotating" step is laid
-- along. Half-way, so a step retraces itself in reverse and a full turn closes its loop.
function PartConstants.midRotation(order, beforeX, beforeY, beforeZ, afterX, afterY, afterZ)
	return PartConstants.composeRotation(order, (beforeX + afterX) * 0.5, (beforeY + afterY) * 0.5, (beforeZ + afterZ) * 0.5)
end

-- Skip Coulomb cancellation below this |a . n|: a body parallel to the surface keeps its gravity.
local FREEFALL_THRESHOLD = 10

-- Coulomb contact shaping of gravity while settling: strips the normal component and applies
-- friction on the tangent velocity, bounded by mu * |aN|.
function PartConstants.applyContactAccel(accel, pData, dt)
	if not (pData._settleEngaged and pData._lastHitNormal) then return accel end
	local n = pData._lastHitNormal
	if n.Magnitude < 1e-4 then return accel end
	local aN_dot = accel:Dot(n)
	-- Gravity pointing away from the surface means no contact.
	if aN_dot >= 0 then return accel end
	-- Body parallel to the surface normal: skip, so gravity drags it along the wall.
	if math.abs(aN_dot) < FREEFALL_THRESHOLD then return accel end
	local aN = aN_dot * n
	local aT = accel - aN
	local mu = (pData.Events and pData.Events.OnHit and pData.Events.OnHit.Friction) or 0.2
	local vT = Vector3.zero
	if pData._accelVel then
		local av = pData._accelVel
		vT = av - av:Dot(n) * n
	end
	local vT_mag = vT.Magnitude
	local maxFrictionAccel = mu * math.abs(aN_dot)
	if vT_mag > 1e-4 then
		-- Kinetic: friction opposes tangent velocity, capped at the Coulomb cone and clamped so it cannot
		-- reverse that velocity in one step.
		local frictionAccel = (-vT.Unit) * maxFrictionAccel
		if maxFrictionAccel * (dt or 1/60) > vT_mag then
			frictionAccel = -vT / (dt or 1/60)
		end
		return aT + frictionAccel
	end
	-- Static: |aT| <= mu * |aN| holds the body still; above that it slides at the residual tangent accel.
	local aT_mag = aT.Magnitude
	if aT_mag <= maxFrictionAccel then return Vector3.zero end
	return aT - aT.Unit * maxFrictionAccel
end

return PartConstants

-- Particles: fires native ParticleEmitters/Trails inside a transformed item from the EmitCount /
-- EmitDelay / EmitDuration attributes. Per-instance gen tokens stop stale delayed-off closures from
-- clobbering newer emit sessions.
-- Particle.fireEmitter is the one place a native ParticleEmitter is fired from (EnableEmit,
-- EnableEmitSingle, the raw-emitter branch of Part/init.luau, the plugin's Emit button via
-- EmitDispatch), so its EmitMode attribute means the same everywhere.
local Range = require(script.Parent.Range)
local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.EngineAttr)
local EmitterBursts = require(script.Parent.EmitterBursts)
local RollLock = require(script.Parent.RollLock)

local Particle = {}

-- EmitDuration is a number or a "min,max" range string; parses to a scalar.
local function parseDuration(raw)
	if raw == nil then return nil end
	if typeof(raw) == "number" then return raw end
	local text = tostring(raw)
	local vals = {}
	for v in text:gmatch("[^,]+") do local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")); if n then table.insert(vals, n) end end
	if #vals == 0 then return nil end
	if #vals == 1 then return vals[1] end
	local mn, mx = math.min(vals[1], vals[2]), math.max(vals[1], vals[2])
	return Range.RandomValueFromRange(NumberRange.new(mn, mx))
end
Particle.parseDuration = parseDuration

-- Skips descendants under a nested Transformed item (the sub-emitter handles those).
local function _hasTransformedAncestor(desc, root)
	local p = desc.Parent
	while p and p ~= root do
		if p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
		p = p.Parent
	end
	return false
end

-- alive false means the engine session ended; cancels delayed starts only.
local function _alive(alive)
	return (not alive) or alive()
end

-- CANCEL_GEN gates delayed starts (bumped by CancelNative / Pool release / Disable). DURATION_GEN
-- gates delayed-off closures (bumped per duration window) so an older window cannot turn off a newer one.
local CANCEL_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeEmitGen"
local DURATION_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeDurationGen"

local function _readCancelGen(v)
	return v:GetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR) or 0
end
local function _bumpCancelGen(v)
	local gen = _readCancelGen(v) + 1
	EngineAttr.write(v, CANCEL_GEN_ATTR, gen)
	return gen
end
local function _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, gen)
	return v.Parent ~= nil and _readCancelGen(v) == gen
end

local function _readDurationGen(v)
	return v:GetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR) or 0
end
local function _bumpDurationGen(v)
	local gen = _readDurationGen(v) + 1
	EngineAttr.write(v, DURATION_GEN_ATTR, gen)
	return gen
end
local function _durationGenStillCurrent(v, gen)
	return v.Parent ~= nil and _readDurationGen(v) == gen
end

-- Enabled=true now, Enabled=false after `duration`; the delayed-off is owned by the duration gen.
Particle.SetEnabledForDuration = function(v, duration)
	local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
	EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
	task.delay(duration, function()
		if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
	end)
end

-- ReadNativeGen / IsNativeGenCurrent address the cancel token (delayed-start gating).
Particle.ReadNativeGen = _readCancelGen
Particle.IsNativeGenCurrent = _cancelGenStillCurrent

-- Bumps cancel and duration gens and sets Enabled=false, invalidating pending starts and delayed-offs.
Particle.CancelNative = function(v)
	_bumpCancelGen(v)
	_bumpDurationGen(v)
	pcall(function() EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end)
end

-- Fires one native ParticleEmitter as its attributes say, after its EmitDelay.
--   EmitMode "Burst": EmitCount particles every 1 / Rate seconds for EmitDuration (EmitterBursts).
--   anything else (Auto): EmitCount particles once, then enabled for EmitDuration when set.
-- EmitCount defaults to 1; a zero count with no duration fires nothing.
-- cancelGen is read before any delay, so a Disable during EmitDelay stops the start.
Particle.fireEmitter = function(emitter, alive)
	local count = tonumber(emitter:GetAttribute("EmitCount")) or 1
	local emitDelay = tonumber(emitter:GetAttribute("EmitDelay")) or 0
	local emitDuration = tonumber(emitter:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")) or 0
	local bursts = emitter:GetAttribute("EmitMode") == "Burst"
	if count <= 0 and (bursts or emitDuration <= 0) then return end
	local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(emitter)
	-- Lock Roll: every particle goes through RollLock's helpers, so an enabled window is a train.
	local locked = RollLock.applies(emitter)
	local emit = locked and RollLock.emit or nil
	local function start()
		if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(emitter, cancelGen) then return end
		if bursts or (locked and emitDuration > 0) then
			-- A train owns the duration gen like an enabled window: a newer emit or CancelNative ends it.
			local durationGen = _bumpDurationGen(emitter)
			if emitter.Enabled then EngineAttr.writeProp(emitter, "Enabled", false) end
			local function stillCurrent()
				return _alive(alive) and _durationGenStillCurrent(emitter, durationGen)
			end
			if bursts then
				EmitterBursts.start(emitter, count, emitDuration, stillCurrent, emit)
			else
				-- Auto: EmitCount now, then one particle every 1 / Rate.
				if count > 0 then RollLock.emit(emitter, count) end
				EmitterBursts.start(emitter, 1, emitDuration, stillCurrent, emit, true)
			end
			return
		end
		-- :Emit(0) falls back to 1; gate on count>0.
		if count > 0 then
			if locked then RollLock.emit(emitter, count) else emitter:Emit(count) end
		end
		if emitDuration > 0 then Particle.SetEnabledForDuration(emitter, emitDuration) end
	end
	if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, start) else start() end
end

-- Synchronous dispatch over everything a holder carries.
Particle.EnableEmit = function(part, alive)
	for i, v in part:GetDescendants() do
		if _hasTransformedAncestor(v, part) then continue end
		if v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
			Particle.fireEmitter(v, alive)
		end
		-- Skip a Transformed TrailEmitter: the engine pipeline emits cloned visuals, and enabling the
		-- source Trail would draw it at default properties over them.
		if v:IsA('Trail') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			local dur = parseDuration(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration'))
			if dur and dur > 0 then
				local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
				task.delay(tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay')) or 0.001, function()
					if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
					task.delay(dur, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
					end)
				end)
			end
		end
		-- Raw Beam: native streak between authored attachments. Skip a Transformed BeamNative (handled by
		-- Particle:EnableEmit). Same gen tokens as Trail.
		if v:IsA('Beam') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			local emitDuration = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration')) or 0
			local emitDelay = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay')) or 0
			if emitDuration > 0 then
				local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
				local function doEmit()
					if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
					local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
					EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
					task.delay(emitDuration, function()
						if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
					end)
				end
				if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEmit) else doEmit() end
			end
		end
	end
end

Particle.EnableEmitSingle = function(v: Instance, alive)
	-- A Transformed source has its own emit pipeline; enabling it here would draw the source or double-fire a nested PE.
	if v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then return end
	if v:IsA('Trail') then
		local dur = parseDuration(v:GetAttribute('EmitDuration'))
		if dur and dur > 0 then
			local cancelGen = _readCancelGen(v)
			local emitDelay = tonumber(v:GetAttribute('EmitDelay')) or 0
			local function doEnable()
				if not _alive(alive) or not _cancelGenStillCurrent(v, cancelGen) then return end
				local durGen = _bumpDurationGen(v)
				EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", true)
				task.delay(dur, function()
					if _durationGenStillCurrent(v, durGen) then EngineAttr.writeProp(v, "Enabled", false) end
				end)
			end
			-- Enable synchronously when EmitDelay=0 so the trail renders on the same frame as the spawn.
			if emitDelay > 0 then task.delay(emitDelay, doEnable) else doEnable() end
		end
	end
	if v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
		Particle.fireEmitter(v, alive)
	end
end

Particle.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments = function(part, alive)
	for i, v in part:GetChildren() do
		Particle.EnableEmitSingle(v, alive)
		if v:IsA('Attachment') and not v:GetAttribute('Transformed') then
			Particle.EnableEmitChildrenAndRepeatForAttachments(v, alive)
		end
	end
end

return Particle

--[[
	PlayHandle: the per-play "ghost" returned by Particle:AbsoluteEmitAt.

	One AbsoluteEmitAt call spawns particles from a SHARED source without cloning it. The handle wraps
	a play token so a caller controls only THAT play: many callers can drive one emitter and stop,
	timescale or script their own play in isolation. No Instance is created; the handle is a plain Lua
	object over { engine, token }.

	token = { Alive, Loops = {task,..}, Clones = {Instance,..}, TsOverride, TsUntil, Duration }.
	Particles of this play carry pData._playToken == token (stamped in RegisterEmit). The continuous
	loop (Lifecycle.Enable) breaks when token.Alive flips false and registers its task in token.Loops.
	Raw clones land in token.Clones for early teardown.

	API:
	  :Disable()      hard stop: no new emission, reclaim live particles now, destroy clones
	  :SoftDisable()  soft stop: no new emission, live particles finish their Lifetime
	  :SetTimescale(scale, duration, permanent)  per-play time warp; no source attribute write
	  :GetParticles() -> {VisualPart,..}  live visuals of this play
	  :GetPDatas()    -> {pData,..}  raw pData refs of live particles; the layout is engine-internal
	                  and may change between plugin versions; mutations apply on the next Heartbeat
	  :IsAlive()      true while any live particle or running loop remains
	  :Wait()         yield until the play ends (Duration elapsed, or disabled with nothing alive);
	                  returns the seconds waited; an infinite play waits for Disable
	  .Active         same as :IsAlive()
	  .Duration       total real-time duration of the play (nil = infinite)
	  PlayHandle.inert(engine)  handle of a rejected call: never alive, controls nothing
]]

local PlayHandle = {}

local Methods = {}

-- Hard stop: halts new emission, reclaims every live particle of this play now, destroys clones.
-- Mirrors Particle:Disable's swap-and-pop sweep, filtered by play token.
function Methods:Disable()
	local engine = self.engine
	-- Queued during the Heartbeat loop; Engine drains after the sweep (see Particle:Disable).
	if engine._inStep then
		engine._afterStep = engine._afterStep or {}
		table.insert(engine._afterStep, function() self:Disable() end)
		return
	end
	local token = self.token
	token.Alive = false
	for _, loopTask in ipairs(token.Loops) do pcall(task.cancel, loopTask) end
	token.Loops = {}

	local active = engine.ActiveEmits
	for idx = #active, 1, -1 do
		local pData = active[idx]
		if pData and pData._playToken == token then
			if pData.VisualPart and pData.VisualPart.Parent then
				engine:_releaseOrDestroy(pData, pData.VisualPart)
			end
			engine:_reclaimPData(pData)
			if active[idx] == pData then
				local n = #active
				if idx < n then active[idx] = active[n] end
				active[n] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	-- Copies of this play that became Reactors and lie where they fell (Reactor/HandOver).
	engine:_endReacted(nil, token)

	for _, clone in ipairs(token.Clones) do
		if clone and clone.Parent then pcall(function() clone:Destroy() end) end
	end
	token.Clones = {}
end

-- Soft stop: halts new emission; live particles finish their Lifetime and clones expire on their
-- own destroy delay. A looping Animate play ends after its current cycle (Engine reads token.Alive).
function Methods:SoftDisable()
	local token = self.token
	token.Alive = false
	for _, loopTask in ipairs(token.Loops) do pcall(task.cancel, loopTask) end
	token.Loops = {}
end

-- Per-play timescale window: patches live particles and stores the window on the token so future
-- emits inherit it (RegisterEmit). Never writes the source item. permanent=true ignores duration;
-- duration<=0 (non-permanent) clears the override.
function Methods:SetTimescale(scale, duration, permanent)
	if typeof(scale) ~= "number" then return end
	local engine = self.engine
	local token = self.token
	local until_
	if permanent == true then
		until_ = math.huge
	elseif typeof(duration) == "number" and duration > 0 then
		until_ = os.clock() + duration
	else
		token.TsOverride = nil
		token.TsUntil = nil
		until_ = nil
	end
	token.TsOverride = until_ ~= nil and scale or nil
	token.TsUntil = until_
	local active = engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		local pData = active[i]
		if pData and pData._playToken == token then
			pData._tsOverride = token.TsOverride
			pData._tsOverrideUntil = until_
		end
	end
end

-- Live visuals of this play, for direct scripting.
function Methods:GetParticles()
	local out = {}
	local active = self.engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		local pData = active[i]
		if pData and pData._playToken == self.token and pData.VisualPart then
			out[#out + 1] = pData.VisualPart
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- Raw pData refs of live particles of this play; the layout is engine-internal and may change
-- between plugin versions. Mutations land on the next Heartbeat read.
function Methods:GetPDatas()
	local out = {}
	local active = self.engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		local pData = active[i]
		if pData and pData._playToken == self.token then
			out[#out + 1] = pData
		end
	end
	return out
end

-- True while any live particle carries the token or any emission loop still runs.
function Methods:IsAlive()
	local active = self.engine.ActiveEmits
	for i = 1, #active do
		if active[i] and active[i]._playToken == self.token then return true end
	end
	for _, loopTask in ipairs(self.token.Loops) do
		if coroutine.status(loopTask) ~= "dead" then return true end
	end
	return false
end

-- Yields until the play ends. Duration is the upper bound (spawns wait on EmitDelay, so liveness
-- alone cannot detect the end); an early Disable returns once nothing is left alive.
function Methods:Wait()
	local start = os.clock()
	local duration = self.Duration
	while true do
		if duration ~= nil and os.clock() - start >= duration then break end
		if self.token.Alive == false and not Methods.IsAlive(self) then break end
		task.wait()
	end
	return os.clock() - start
end

local HandleMeta = {}
-- .Active resolves live; .Duration and methods are real fields or in Methods.
HandleMeta.__index = function(handle, key)
	if key == "Active" then return Methods.IsAlive(handle) end
	return Methods[key]
end

function PlayHandle.new(engine, token)
	return setmetatable({ engine = engine, token = token, Duration = token.Duration }, HandleMeta)
end

-- Handle for a rejected call so callers can chain methods without nil checks.
function PlayHandle.inert(engine)
	return PlayHandle.new(engine, { Alive = false, Loops = {}, Clones = {}, Duration = 0 })
end

return PlayHandle

-- Where a light or a sound rides, and the carrier made for it (nil when none): Emit Into, else
-- the parent copy's copy of the part or attachment the source sits in, else the link (a Model
-- is narrowed to one of its parts by Particle._partOfHost), else a carrier for the source's own part or
-- attachment, so the visual never parents into the user's part (Team Create replication). That
-- carrier mirrors the source, or stands at the origin of a play EmitAt or an event moved there.
-- Shared by EmitPointLight and EmitSound.
function Particle._rideHost(item, data, link, emitCtx)

	if host then return host, nil end
	local anchor = item.Parent
	if not (anchor and (anchor:IsA("BasePart") or anchor:IsA("Attachment"))) then
		return anchor, nil
	end
	local frame, tiedToSource = Constants.playOrigin(Constants.resolveLinkCFrame(anchor), emitCtx)
	local fixedFrame = nil
	if not tiedToSource then
		fixedFrame = frame
	end
	local carrier = VisualHost.acquireCarrier(anchor, fixedFrame)
	return carrier, carrier
end

-- Lights and positional sounds only play under a BasePart/Attachment. A Model host resolves to
-- its middle part. With `boltFanOut` a Lightning bolt resolves to its first segment and returns
-- ALL its segments second, for the light's per-segment clone fan-out so the whole bolt glows.
-- Shared by EmitPointLight (fan-out) and EmitSound (middle part).
function Particle._partOfHost(host, boltFanOut)
	if not (host and host:IsA("Model")) then return host, nil end
	local parts = nil
	for _, child in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("BasePart") then
			parts = parts or {}
			parts[#parts + 1] = child
		end
	end
	if not parts then return host, nil end
	if boltFanOut and host:GetAttribute("_lightningBolt") then return parts[1], parts end
	return parts[math.ceil(#parts / 2)], nil
end

function Particle:UpdatePointLight(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- SetTimescale override wins for its window (signed reverse: see Update.luau UpdatePart).
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	local dtTs = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dtTs)
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
		local steppedI = pData.CurrentStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames

		local range, brightness, color, angle
		if pData.Graphs.PLRange then
			range = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLRange, pData.Seeds.PLRange)
			pData.VisualPart.Range = range
		end
		-- A Container's Transparency dims the light by the same opacity (Container/Fade); back at
		-- no fade, its own brightness is written once.
		local fade = ContainerFade.of(pData._drive)
		if (pData.Graphs.PLBrightness or fade ~= 0 or pData._lightFaded) and not pData.SkipTransparency then
			brightness = pData._lightBase
			if pData.Graphs.PLBrightness then
				brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLBrightness, pData.Seeds.PLBrightness)
			end
			brightness = ContainerFade.light(brightness, fade)
			pData._lightFaded = fade ~= 0
			pData.VisualPart.Brightness = brightness
		end
		if pData.Graphs.PLColor and not pData.SkipColor then
			color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLColor)
			pData.VisualPart.Color = color
		end
		if pData._hasCone and pData.Graphs.PLAngle then
			angle = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(steppedI, pData.Graphs.PLAngle, pData.Seeds.PLAngle)
			pData.VisualPart.Angle = angle
		end
		local extras = pData._extraLights
		if extras then
			for j = 1, #extras do
				local extraLight = extras[j]
				if range then extraLight.Range = range end
				if brightness then extraLight.Brightness = brightness end
				if color then extraLight.Color = color end
				if angle then extraLight.Angle = angle end
			end
		end
	end

	return isDying
end

function Particle:EmitPointLight(light, link, emitCtx)
	if not light or not light.Parent then return end
	local data = self:GetEmitData(light, emitCtx)
	if not data or not data.RenderTemplate then return end

	-- PoolHide flipped Enabled=false on release; flip back here.
	local visualLight = Pool.acquireOrClone(data.RenderTemplate, "PointLight", data.Pool)
	visualLight.Archivable = false
	visualLight.Enabled = true
	if data.Shadows ~= nil then visualLight.Shadows = data.Shadows end
	local host, carrier = Particle._rideHost(light, data, link, emitCtx)
	local parentPart, boltParts = Particle._partOfHost(host, true)

	local safeLifeTime = RangeMod.RandomValueFromRange(data.Lifetime)
	if safeLifeTime <= 0 then safeLifeTime = 0.001 end

	local seedRange = data.PLRange and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLRange) or {}
	local seedBright = data.PLBrightness and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLBrightness) or {}
	local seedAngle = data.PLAngle and GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLAngle) or {}
	local seedTimescale = GraphMod.GenerateSeed(data.PLTimescale)

	-- Apply initial values before parenting (1-frame pop prevention).
	if data.PLRange then
		visualLight.Range = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLRange, seedRange)
	end
	if data.PLBrightness then
		visualLight.Brightness = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLBrightness, seedBright)
	end
	-- Carried by a Container: its fade dims the light from the first frame.
	local containerDrive = emitCtx and emitCtx._containerDrive
	local lightBase = visualLight.Brightness
	if containerDrive then
		visualLight.Brightness = ContainerFade.light(lightBase, containerDrive.transparency)
	end
	if data.PLColor then
		visualLight.Color = GraphMod.QueryColorPointWithTime(0, data.PLColor)
	end
	-- Spot / Surface lights carry a cone; PointLight has neither Angle nor Face.
	local hasCone = visualLight:IsA("SpotLight") or visualLight:IsA("SurfaceLight")
	if hasCone then
		if data.PLFace then visualLight.Face = data.PLFace end
		if data.PLAngle then visualLight.Angle = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(0, data.PLAngle, seedAngle) end
	end

	visualLight.Parent = parentPart

	-- Lightning per-segment fan-out: clone the initialized light onto every other segment;
	-- UpdatePointLight drives the clones with the same stepped values and _releaseOrDestroy destroys
	-- them. Archivable flips because Clone() returns nil on Archivable=false instances.
	local extraLights = nil
	if boltParts and #boltParts > 1 then
		visualLight.Archivable = true
		extraLights = table.create(#boltParts - 1)
		for j = 2, #boltParts do
			local extra = visualLight:Clone()
			extra.Archivable = false
			extra.Parent = boltParts[j]
			extraLights[j - 1] = extra
		end
		visualLight.Archivable = false
	end

	local pData = {
		Type = "PointLight",
		_carrier = carrier,
		_hasCone = hasCone,
		VisualPart = visualLight,
		Events = data.Events,
		StartTime = os.clock(),
		TotalKeyFrames = math.max(1, data.TotalKeyFrames),
		CurrentStep = 0,
		LifeTime = safeLifeTime,
		PartLife = data.PartLife or 0,

		Graphs = {
			PLRange = data.PLRange,
			PLBrightness = data.PLBrightness,
			PLColor = data.PLColor,
			PLAngle = data.PLAngle,
			Timescale = data.PLTimescale,
		},
		Seeds = {
			PLRange = seedRange,
			PLBrightness = seedBright,
			PLAngle = seedAngle,
			Timescale = seedTimescale,
		},
		_effectiveElapsed = GraphMod.InitialEffectiveElapsed(data.PLTimescale, seedTimescale, safeLifeTime),
	}

	pData._sourceItem = light
	pData._extraLights = extraLights
	pData._drive = containerDrive
	pData._lightBase = lightBase
	pData._lightFaded = containerDrive ~= nil and containerDrive.transparency ~= 0
	if ContainerFade.fading(containerDrive) then pData._noPool = true end
	-- Parented INSIDE the emitted visual, the light must die with it, or a pooled parent carries live
	-- foreign lights back into the pool. Lights Emit Into puts elsewhere keep their own lifetime.
	pData._parentAlive = NestedEmit.parentAliveFor(data, emitCtx)
	Particle._seedTsOverride(pData, light)
	if data.Pool ~= false then pData._sourceRT, pData._poolKind = data.RenderTemplate, "PointLight" end
	self:_registerEmit(pData, emitCtx)
end

end

--[[
	Pool: emission-driven object pool for emitted particle visuals.
	Per-source LIFO with a hard cap (rate*TTL*1.25 + 8), ring-buffer overflow and TTL eviction.
	Entries are invalidated by generation (`_PoolGen`, bumped by TypeRegistry.write). Animate mode
	skips pooling (the visual is the live source).
]]

local PoolHide = require(script.Parent.PoolHide)
local VisualHost = require(script.Parent.VisualHost)
local AtRest = require(script.Parent.AtRest)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Log)
local InstanceMap = require(script.Parent.InstanceMap)

local Pool = {}

-- Idle-pool folder (VisualHost owns it). Live emit clones stay in `EmittedPartsUsingPart_icle`.
local function _getPoolFolder()
	return VisualHost.getPoolFolder()
end

-- [sourceRT] = {entries, gen, cap, peakSize, hits, misses, evictions}. Strong keys: tickSweep must
-- still find a destroyed source's entries to destroy them.
Pool._pools = {}
Pool._totalSize = 0
Pool._lastSweepAt = 0
Pool._lastReportAt = 0
-- Bumped per release; particles capture it at emit so a recycled clone is no longer their link.
Pool._releaseGen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

Pool.MAX_POOL_TOTAL = 2048
Pool.TTL = 5
Pool.SWEEP_INTERVAL = 2
Pool.REPORT_INTERVAL = 0        -- 0 disables the periodic Output print
Pool.MIN_CAP = 8
Pool.CAP_SAFETY = 1.25

local function estimateCap(rate)
	local r = math.max(rate or 0, 0)
	return math.ceil(r * Pool.TTL * Pool.CAP_SAFETY) + Pool.MIN_CAP
end

local function getOrInitPool(source)
	local p = Pool._pools[source]
	if p then return p end
	p = {
		entries = {},                              -- LIFO of {instance, pooledAt}
		gen = source:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0,
		cap = Pool.MIN_CAP,
		peakSize = 0,
		hits = 0, misses = 0, evictions = 0,
	}
	Pool._pools[source] = p
	return p
end

-- A copy's map goes by itself when the copy is destroyed (InstanceMap); a copy let go another way
-- drops its map here.
function Pool.dropCloneMap(instance)
	if instance then Pool._cloneMaps:set(instance, nil) end
end

-- The source -> clone map of a copy Pool made (copyBare), or nil.
function Pool.cloneMapOf(copy)
	return Pool._cloneMaps:get(copy)
end

local function destroyEntry(entry)
	if entry and entry.instance then
		Pool.dropCloneMap(entry.instance)
		pcall(function() entry.instance:Destroy() end)
	end
end

local function discardAllEntries(pool)
	for i = 1, #pool.entries do destroyEntry(pool.entries[i]) end
	Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - #pool.entries)
	pool.entries = {}
end

-- Pops a live entry or nil. The caller restores all visual properties as for a fresh Clone.
function Pool.acquire(source, kind)
	if not source then return nil end
	local pool = getOrInitPool(source)
	local sourceGen = source:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	if sourceGen ~= pool.gen then
		-- Generation drifted: flush all entries.
		discardAllEntries(pool)
		pool.gen = sourceGen
	end
	while #pool.entries > 0 do
		local entry = table.remove(pool.entries)
		Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - 1)
		local inst = entry.instance
		if inst and inst.Parent then
			PoolHide.show(inst, kind)
			pool.hits += 1
			return inst
		end
	end
	pool.misses += 1
	return nil
end

-- Pushes an instance back. Over the global cap it is destroyed; a full per-source pool evicts the oldest.
function Pool.release(instance, source, kind, rate)
	if not instance or not source then return end
	if not instance.Parent then return end
	local pool = getOrInitPool(source)
	if rate then pool.cap = estimateCap(rate) end
	if Pool._totalSize >= Pool.MAX_POOL_TOTAL then
		Pool.dropCloneMap(instance)
		pcall(function() instance:Destroy() end)
		return
	end
	while #pool.entries >= pool.cap do
		local oldest = table.remove(pool.entries, 1)  -- O(n) shift, n <= cap
		Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - 1)
		destroyEntry(oldest)
		pool.evictions += 1
	end
	PoolHide.hide(instance, kind)
	Pool._releaseGen[instance] = (Pool._releaseGen[instance] or 0) + 1
	-- Visible in the pool folder so the Explorer shows which clones are recyclable.
	pcall(function() instance.Parent = _getPoolFolder() end)
	pool.entries[#pool.entries + 1] = { instance = instance, pooledAt = os.clock() }
	Pool._totalSize += 1
	if #pool.entries > pool.peakSize then pool.peakSize = #pool.entries end
end

function Pool.linkGen(instance)
	return Pool._releaseGen[instance] or 0
end

-- TTL sweep with a 64-entry budget to cap frame time.
function Pool.tickSweep(now)
	if (now - Pool._lastSweepAt) < Pool.SWEEP_INTERVAL then return end
	Pool._lastSweepAt = now
	local budget = 64
	-- Drained sources are dropped after the loop (mutating Pool._pools while iterating skips entries).
	-- Droppable: no entries and the source RT is destroyed, so live RTs keep their stats.
	local toDrop = nil
	for source, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		local i = 1
		while i <= #pool.entries and budget > 0 do
			local entry = pool.entries[i]
			local inst = entry.instance
			local stale = (now - entry.pooledAt) > Pool.TTL or not inst or not inst.Parent
			if stale then
				destroyEntry(entry)
				local n = #pool.entries
				if i < n then pool.entries[i] = pool.entries[n] end
				pool.entries[n] = nil
				Pool._totalSize = math.max(0, Pool._totalSize - 1)
				pool.evictions += 1
				budget -= 1
				-- Do not advance i: the slot now holds what was at the end.
			else
				i += 1
			end
		end
		if #pool.entries == 0 and (not source or not source.Parent) then
			toDrop = toDrop or {}
			toDrop[#toDrop + 1] = source
		end
	end
	if toDrop then
		for _, source in ipairs(toDrop) do
			Pool._pools[source] = nil
		end
	end
end

-- Called from TypeRegistry.write to invalidate stale pool entries.
function Pool.bumpGen(source)
	if not source then return end
	local cur = source:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() source:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

-- Drop one source's pool when its RT is destroyed.
function Pool.flushSource(source)
	local pool = Pool._pools[source]
	if not pool then return end
	discardAllEntries(pool)
	Pool._pools[source] = nil
end

-- Drop every pool; called from Particle:Deactivate.
function Pool.flushAll()
	for _, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		discardAllEntries(pool)
	end
	Pool._pools = {}
	Pool._totalSize = 0
	Pool._cloneMaps:clear()
end

-- Aggregate diagnostics print, gated by REPORT_INTERVAL.
function Pool.tickReport(now)
	if Pool.REPORT_INTERVAL <= 0 then return end
	if (now - Pool._lastReportAt) < Pool.REPORT_INTERVAL then return end
	Pool._lastReportAt = now
	local poolCount, totalEntries, totalHits, totalMisses, totalEvictions, peakAcross = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
	for _ in pairs(Pool._pools) do poolCount += 1 end
	for _, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		totalEntries += #pool.entries
		totalHits += pool.hits
		totalMisses += pool.misses
		totalEvictions += pool.evictions
		if pool.peakSize > peakAcross then peakAcross = pool.peakSize end
	end
	local hitRate = (totalHits + totalMisses) > 0 and (totalHits / (totalHits + totalMisses) * 100) or 0
	Log.print(string.format(
		"[Part-Icles Pool] sources=%d entries=%d/%d peak=%d hits=%d misses=%d (%.1f%% hit) evictions=%d",
		poolCount, totalEntries, Pool.MAX_POOL_TOTAL, peakAcross, totalHits, totalMisses, hitRate, totalEvictions
	))
end

-- Acquires or clones; stamps _PartIcleEmit. `pooled=false` forces a fresh clone every time so
-- nested Trails/PEs reflect their authored RT properties.
function Pool.acquireOrClone(rt, kind, pooled)
	local inst
	if pooled == false then
		inst = rt:Clone()
	else
		inst = Pool.acquire(rt, kind) or rt:Clone()
	end
	inst:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return inst
end

local END_PROPERTIES = { "Attachment0", "Attachment1" }

-- Clone map -> { { clone, property, source }, ... }: stock Beam / Trail ends authored against a
-- transformed Attachment. The copy skips that attachment, so the end waits until registerEmitted binds it.
local lateEnds = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

-- Rebuilds the RT subtree via Instance.fromExisting, skipping Transformed branches (nested sources,
-- fired by NestedEmit). Builds a source-to-clone map and points a Model's PrimaryPart at its copy.
-- A Beam or Light the RenderTemplate keeps off at rest is on in the copy (AtRest).
local function copyBare(source, map, isRoot)
	map = map or {}
	local bare = Instance.fromExisting(source)
	AtRest.wakeCopy(bare)
	map[source] = bare
	for _, child in ipairs(source:GetChildren()) do
		-- Skip nested sources (fired separately) and any live emitted visual that landed here.
		if not child:GetAttribute("Transformed") and not child:GetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit") then
			copyBare(child, map, false).Parent = bare
		end
	end
	-- Rebinds Trail/Beam Attachment0/1 inside the subtree (fromExisting copies refs verbatim). An end on
	-- a transformed Attachment goes to lateEnds; any other miss keeps its authored reference.
	if isRoot == nil or isRoot then
		local late = nil
		for src, clone in pairs(map) do
			if src:IsA("Trail") or src:IsA("Beam") then
				for _, property in ipairs(END_PROPERTIES) do
					local authored = src[property]
					if authored and map[authored] then
						clone[property] = map[authored]
					elseif authored and authored:GetAttribute("Transformed") then
						late = late or {}
						table.insert(late, { clone = clone, property = property, source = authored })
					end
				end
			elseif src:IsA("Model") and src.PrimaryPart then
				-- A Model's pivot is its PrimaryPart's; nil when that part is a nested source and not copied.
				clone.PrimaryPart = map[src.PrimaryPart]
			end
		end
		lateEnds[map] = late
	end
	return bare, map
end
Pool.copyBare = copyBare

-- Records `visual` as the emitted copy of the transformed `source` in a parent's clone map and
-- binds the Beam / Trail ends waiting for it. Writes own entries only (the map may chain to a
-- grandparent's). Consumer: EmitAttachment.
function Pool.registerEmitted(map, source, visual)
	rawset(map, source, visual)
	local late = lateEnds[map]
	if not late then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(late) do
		if entry.source == source then entry.clone[entry.property] = visual end
	end
end

-- A reused clone starts like a fresh copy: late ends back on their authored attachment, emitted
-- attachments forgotten.
local function resetLateEnds(map)
	local late = lateEnds[map]
	if not late then return end
	for _, entry in ipairs(late) do
		entry.clone[entry.property] = entry.source
		rawset(map, entry.source, nil)
	end
end

-- Copy root -> its clone map while the copy lives (not a weak table: Roblox drops a live instance
-- from one, docs/bug-prevention.md). Pool hits reuse it until _PoolGen drifts.
Pool._cloneMaps = InstanceMap.new()

function Pool.acquireOrCopyBare(rt, kind, pooled)
	local inst, map
	if pooled == false then
		inst, map = copyBare(rt)
	else
		inst = Pool.acquire(rt, kind)
		if inst then
			map = Pool._cloneMaps:get(inst)
			if map then resetLateEnds(map) end
		else
			inst, map = copyBare(rt)
		end
	end
	if map then Pool._cloneMaps:set(inst, map) end
	inst:SetAttribute("_PartIcleEmit", true)
	return inst
end

-- Call AFTER writing the new spawn CFrame and parent. Defers the Trail.Enabled flip one Heartbeat
-- so the renderer has the new attachment positions; otherwise the first segment streaks from the
-- previous death pose. No-op on fresh clones.
function Pool.restoreTrails(instance, kind)
	task.delay(0, function()
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
		PoolHide.restoreTrails(instance, kind)
	end)
end

-- Heartbeat hook; each subsystem gates on its own interval.
function Pool.tick(now)
	Pool.tickSweep(now)
	Pool.tickReport(now)
end

function Pool.stats()
	local out = { totalSize = Pool._totalSize, sources = {} }
	for source, pool in pairs(Pool._pools) do
		out.sources[source] = {
			size = #pool.entries, peakSize = pool.peakSize, cap = pool.cap, gen = pool.gen,
			hits = pool.hits, misses = pool.misses, evictions = pool.evictions,
		}
	end
	return out
end

return Pool

--[[
	PoolHide: type-dispatched hide/show for pooled visuals.

	hide: Part/Model teleport far away (Trails disabled first to avoid a streak); Beam/PointLight
	      Enabled=false; Attachment no-op.
	show: no-op; Trails are restored by PoolHide.restoreTrails after the caller writes the new spawn CFrame.

	The caller's emit setup rewrites Size / CFrame / Color / Transparency on acquire; PoolHide does not
	restore rendering properties.
]]

local FAR_AWAY = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
local FAR_CFRAME = CFrame.new(FAR_AWAY)

local PoolHide = {}

-- Snapshots and disables every Trail descendant, BEFORE the teleport. Lifetime is zeroed too:
-- Enabled=false stops only new segments, and old ones would draw a streak across the teleport.
-- Skips the snapshot when one is pending so a same-frame acquire/release cannot overwrite the
-- authored value.
local function disableTrails(root)
	if root:IsA("Trail") then
		pcall(function()
			if root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled") == nil then
				root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", root.Enabled)
			end
			if root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime") == nil then
				root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", root.Lifetime)
			end
			root.Lifetime = 0
			root.Enabled = false
		end)
		return
	end
	for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Trail") then
			pcall(function()
				if desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled") == nil then
					desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", desc.Enabled)
				end
				if desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime") == nil then
					desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", desc.Lifetime)
				end
				desc.Lifetime = 0
				desc.Enabled = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Restores each Trail's Lifetime and Enabled from the snapshot and clears the attributes.
local function restoreTrails(root)
	if root:IsA("Trail") then
		pcall(function()
			local priorLife = root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime")
			if priorLife ~= nil then root.Lifetime = priorLife end
			root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", nil)
			local prior = root:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled")
			if prior ~= nil then root.Enabled = prior == true end
			root:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", nil)
		end)
		return
	end
	for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Trail") then
			pcall(function()
				local priorLife = desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime")
				if priorLife ~= nil then desc.Lifetime = priorLife end
				desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailLifetime", nil)
				local prior = desc:GetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled")
				if prior ~= nil then desc.Enabled = prior == true end
				desc:SetAttribute("_pooledTrailEnabled", nil)
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- Bumps cancel + duration gens and disables nested ParticleEmitter / Trail descendants, so pending
-- delayed starts from Particles.EnableEmit cannot land on a reused pooled visual.
local CANCEL_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeEmitGen"
local DURATION_GEN_ATTR = "_PartIcleNativeDurationGen"
local function cancelNativeDescendants(root)
	for _, desc in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail") then
			pcall(function()
				local cancelCur = desc:GetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR) or 0
				desc:SetAttribute(CANCEL_GEN_ATTR, cancelCur + 1)
				local durCur = desc:GetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR) or 0
				desc:SetAttribute(DURATION_GEN_ATTR, durCur + 1)
				desc.Enabled = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

function PoolHide.hide(instance, kind)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end

	if kind == "Part" then
		-- disableTrails first, so the snapshot reads the authored Trail.Enabled.
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
		if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			pcall(function() instance.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME end)
		end

	-- Model keeps PivotTo: EmitModel moves clones through the pivot every frame; Lightning maintains
	-- WorldPivot per roll (applyRoll).
	elseif kind == "Model" or kind == "Lightning" then
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
		pcall(function() instance:PivotTo(FAR_CFRAME) end)

	elseif kind == "Rocks" or kind == "Rope" then
		-- Rig kinds move parts with BulkMoveTo, which never updates a PrimaryPart-less Model's STORED
		-- pivot, so park every part directly and never trust the pivot.
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
		for _, chunk in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if chunk:IsA("BasePart") then
				pcall(function()
					chunk.Anchored = true
					chunk.CanCollide = false
					chunk.CanTouch = false
					chunk.CFrame = FAR_CFRAME
				end)
			end
		end

	elseif kind == "Beam" then
		-- Snapshots Color + Transparency so a reacquire with no colorStates graph restores authored values.
		pcall(function()
			if instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor") == nil then
				instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor", instance.Color)
			end
			if instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency") == nil then
				instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency", instance.Transparency)
			end
			instance.Enabled = false
		end)

	elseif kind == "PointLight" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = false end)

	elseif kind == "Highlight" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = false end)

	elseif kind == "TrailEmitter" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = false end)

	elseif kind == "ImageLabel" then
		-- ImageLabel has no .Enabled; Visible=false hides it. Pool.release re-parents to the pool folder
		-- (a GUI under a non-ScreenGui ancestor does not render).
		pcall(function() instance.Visible = false end)

	elseif kind == "Attachment" then
		-- The Attachment stays at its pose; native PE/Trail descendants are cancelled so stale delayed
		-- starts cannot re-emit. disableTrails first, as in the Part / Model branches.
		disableTrails(instance)
		cancelNativeDescendants(instance)
	-- Visible is untouched: authored Attachments default to false, and toggling would show a 3D gizmo.
	end
end

function PoolHide.show(instance, kind)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
	-- Symmetric with hide: the Enabled flips stay inside the pool contract.
	if kind == "Beam" then
		-- Restores authored Color + Transparency before re-enable: emit setup writes them only when a graph
		-- is non-empty, so a pooled Beam with no graph would keep the prior cycle's last frame.
		pcall(function()
			local priorColor = instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor")
			if priorColor ~= nil then instance.Color = priorColor end
			instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamColor", nil)
			local priorTrans = instance:GetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency")
			if priorTrans ~= nil then instance.Transparency = priorTrans end
			instance:SetAttribute("_pooledBeamTransparency", nil)
			instance.Enabled = true
		end)
	elseif kind == "PointLight" or kind == "Highlight" or kind == "TrailEmitter" then
		pcall(function() instance.Enabled = true end)
	elseif kind == "ImageLabel" then
		pcall(function() instance.Visible = true end)
	end
	-- Trails are restored by PoolHide.restoreTrails after the caller sets the new CFrame.
end

-- Call AFTER setting the new spawn CFrame. Restores Trail.Enabled from the snapshot; no-op on fresh
-- clones.
function PoolHide.restoreTrails(instance, kind)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then return end
	if kind == "Part" or kind == "Model" or kind == "Attachment" or kind == "Lightning" or kind == "Rocks" or kind == "Rope" then
		restoreTrails(instance)
	end
end

return PoolHide

--[[
	Preload: asks the engine for images ahead of their first use, so a flipbook's first frames are
	there when shown.

	ContentProvider:PreloadAsync loads what an INSTANCE refers to (a Decal's Texture, an ImageLabel's
	Image). A content id handed over as a string is refused (the call answers AssetFetchStatus.Failure
	within a frame or two and loads nothing), so an id is wrapped in an ImageLabel that is never parented.

	  Preload.ask(entries)   fire and forget; a string id is asked for once a session
	  Preload.wait(entries)  yields until the engine has answered for every entry
	entries: an array of instances and / or content id strings.

	Loading is not keeping: the engine may drop an image nothing shows. Modules/Part/TexturePin keeps
	images resident (the Preload Texture switch).
]]

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")

local Preload = {}

-- Content ids already asked for through Preload.ask.
local asked = {}

-- The entries as instances; the second value lists the carriers made here, to be destroyed.
local function carriersFor(entries, once)
	local instances = {}
	local made = {}
	for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do
		if typeof(entry) == "Instance" then
			table.insert(instances, entry)
		elseif type(entry) == "string" and entry ~= "" and not (once and asked[entry]) then
			if once then
				asked[entry] = true
			end
			local carrier = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
			carrier.Image = entry
			table.insert(instances, carrier)
			table.insert(made, carrier)
		end
	end
	return instances, made
end

local function load(instances, made)
	if #instances > 0 then
		pcall(ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, instances)
	end
	for _, carrier in ipairs(made) do
		carrier:Destroy()
	end
end

function Preload.ask(entries)
	local instances, made = carriersFor(entries, true)
	if #instances == 0 then
		return
	end
	task.spawn(load, instances, made)
end

function Preload.wait(entries)
	local instances, made = carriersFor(entries, false)
	load(instances, made)
end

return Preload
